title: Permissions: View-only cannot create a part; Create and Edit without Delete can create a tracked part
custom_preconds:
• Role A: Part Library and Inventory View only.
  • Role B: View + Create and Edit, Delete unticked.
custom_steps:
1. As role A open Parts > Inventory.
  2. As role A replay POST /api/inventory/parts/create with a valid typed body.
  3. As role B create a tracked part from New Inventory Part.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • No New Inventory Part button.

Step 2:

  • 403; nothing created.

Step 3:

  • Saves (201); the row shows the part.
